data.title: Swell Surge Watch: Alappuzha
data.description: Swell Surge Watch for the coast of ALAPPUZHA,KERALA from Chellanum To AzheekalJetty. Swell waves in the range of 16.0 - 17.0 sec period with 0.4 - 0.5 m height are forecasted during  20:30 hours on 14-11-2026 to 23:30 hours on 16-11-2026. It advised that no immediate action is required. Check for updates.
